editions.headline: Improving movement mechanics and map documentation in Civ13
editions.intro: I have merged fixes for diagonal human movement and map compilation to improve how players navigate the world. I am also continuing to expand our documentation, merging new map pages for Gaia and Nomads into the `civ13-wiki`.

sections.title: Civ13 gameplay and world design
sections.body:
To further refine the player experience, I have opened pull requests to address minimap grid labels, "prone continuous pulses," and overlaps in "throw launch" mechanics. I am also working on features to restore owned Nomad characters at assigned beds and to introduce request-bound local process facts.

Our environmental and exploration work continues through "liminal design" and "backrooms expedition" projects, where I have been updating room rendering and expedition furnishings. To add more life to the landscape, I have opened pull requests to include decorative wildflower types and ecology activity heatmaps.

sections.title: DiscordPHP and bot updates
sections.body:
In `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket`, I have opened several pull requests to refine combat logic, specifically aiming to keep countered abilities from moving source cards, preserve frozen targets during paid damage, and support "Garza Assassin" payment recoveries. I am also working on implementing "pure flame damage continuations" and addressing "disguise copy characteristics."

Regarding other projects, I merged a fix for Windows admin-list framing in `Civilizationbot` and opened a pull request for authoritative admin-sync foundations. In `DiscordPHP`, I merged an update to document and verify optional lobby names.

editions.headline: Advancing Civ13 survival mechanics and MTGPocket verification
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to `Civ13` to refine core survival loops, specifically improving the correctness of husbandry and fishing systems and adding yeast bread cooking. I am also working on a proposal to plan procedurally generated `Civ13` surface worlds.

sections.title: Civ13 systems and infrastructure
sections.body: To improve engine stability, I merged fixes for redundant gameplay loops, lost scheduler progress, and gaps in crafted items. I am continuing work on the BYOND 516.1688 runtime acceptance and making improvements to the CI/CD pipeline. On the gameplay side, I have opened pull requests to address human drop mechanics, mutual shard transfer policies, and the implementation of era-specific dictionary replacements. Ongoing environmental work continues to focus on snowfall mechanics, seasonal construction persistence, and lighting research.

sections.title: DiscordPHP updates
sections.body: In `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket`, I merged fixes for specific card mechanics, including death counters for "Quest for the Gravelord," target clauses for "Soul Stair Expedition," and counters for "Quest for Ancient Secrets." I also merged updates to the `DiscordPHP.org` website to address display names and community links.

editions.headline: Advancing Civ13 environmental mechanics and cloud metadata
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to `Civ13` focusing on environmental persistence, including snow accumulation, native zone persistence, and elevation metadata. This work includes documenting reproducible native cloud-rendered stills and validating zone data within the engine.

sections.title: Gameplay evolution and engine compatibility
sections.body:
To expand survival depth in `Civ13`, I merged improvements to tree growth mechanics and added a requirement for shovels when uprooting seedlings. I have also opened pull requests to introduce winter food crops, such as turnips and plump helmets, and to add character discovery elements like berry scents. I am also working on a design for balanced nutritional diets.

On the technical side, I am working to ensure compatibility with BYOND 516.1688, using various CI branches to test client and cloud-bakery scenarios. I have also opened a pull request to retire unverified legacy BYOND installer entrypoints.

sections.title: Tooling and other projects
sections.body: In `DiscordPHP`, I am developing a feature branch that proposes an asynchronous Windows RPC pipe helper to help keep loop heartbeats independent of Windows spawn latency. In `Frontier-Systems`, I opened a pull request to propose a design research knowledgebase and a rendering experiment plan. Finally, I merged an approved mission statement onto the `valgorithms.com` homepage.

editions.headline: Expanding MTGPocket card coverage and Civ13 documentation
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket` to address card coverage gaps and resolve search issues for specific cards, including "Burnished Hart," "Harrow Land," and "Farseek."

sections.title: Civ13 roadmap and documentation updates
sections.body:
In `Civ13`, I merged pull requests #3302, #3303, and #3305 to support ongoing engine development. I have also been updating the project's documentation, merging new roadmap and mapping guides to the `civ13.github.io` site and the `civ13-wiki`. As part of a shift in project priorities, I have closed two pull requests related to "OpenDream" without merging them, as that work is currently discontinued.

I recently shared a broad roadmap for the future of `Civ13`, which aims to move toward deeper historical survival and persistent worlds. This direction involves expanding resource and production chains—such as textiles and chemistry—and improving farming and food mechanics. To support this, I am working on enhancing world persistence through better saving and movement logic, with long-term plans to introduce industrialization tools like pipes and pumps.

editions.headline: Refining Civ13 gameplay loops and lighting
editions.intro: I have opened an issue in `Civ13` to audit and fix redundant gameplay loops and lost scheduler progress. This work includes work on wolf cave timer ownership, movement discovery subsets, and refinements to lighting plane mask composition.

sections.title: System and bot updates
sections.body:
In `Frontier-Systems`, I merged three pull requests (#128, #129, and #130) and have opened four new ones (#131 through #134) to propose further changes to the system. I am also continuing development on `Civilizationbot`, where I merged two updates and opened a new pull request (#24).

Regarding my work with `DiscordPHP`, I merged a pull request to `DiscordPHP-NHA` to address changes in the NHA server API contract. I have also opened a new pull request (#331) for `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket` to continue expanding its capabilities.

editions.headline: Releasing Civ13 Launcher 1.0.7
editions.intro: I have released version 1.0.7 of the `Civ13` launcher, which includes a fix to prevent players from joining immediately after verified server discovery.

sections.title: Engine and community updates
sections.body:
In `Civ13`, I merged experimental lighting overlays for inactive reserved cells and added clearance guards. I also pushed an update to extraction survival mode to fail closed on malformed recovery inventory roots and nodes. To support performance testing, I am working on aligning save benchmarks for `bounded-world-save`. To help organize our growing knowledge base, I have opened a pull request to define the mission and community standards for the `civ13.github.io` wiki.

In other projects, I released `DiscordPHP` version 10.69.0 and merged an update to `Civilizationbot` that adds an opt-in live launcher server directory. I am also working on separating disabled-source review from safehouse activation evidence in `Civilizationbot`.

editions.headline: Releasing Civ13 Launcher 1.0.6
editions.intro: I have released version 1.0.6 of the `Civ13` launcher, which includes cached server status to help preserve cooldowns across restarts. This follows the 1.0.5 release, which addressed single-file containment logging configuration and clarified YouTube review run guard refusals.

sections.title: Engine stability and bot updates
sections.body:
To improve the reliability of the `Civ13` environment, I merged a passive monotonic watchdog to detect hangs in the Nomads system and added recovery verification tooling for the Gaia and Europe maps. I also addressed issues with extraction loot handoffs and adjusted research and mining restrictions, such as restricting rock mining to pickaxes. To support maintenance, I have opened a pull request to save and stop canonical Nomads processes before updating or compiling.

In other projects, I merged an update to `Civilizationbot` to improve nomad status freshness and merged an update to the `DiscordPHP` OpenAPI schema to address changes in the Discord API.

editions.headline: Integrating gameplay footage uploads for Civ13
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to manage how gameplay footage is uploaded and verified, enrolling specific recordings—such as weapon attachments and train footage—into a reviewed YouTube uploader. This work includes new logic for rescheduling reviewed uploads and handling protected environment secrets to keep the uploader secure.

sections.title: Infrastructure and documentation updates
sections.body:
In `Civ13`, I merged improvements to the system foundation, including a new identity and lease foundation for inactive extraction instances and a fix to keep bronze production and research evidence together during help retrieval. I also merged a fix to preserve wildlife peers during registry retirement. To support these systems, I have opened a pull request to add a guarded native bot supervisor consumer.

Work on the `civ13.github.io` site has progressed with the publication of a source-pinned architecture and UML atlas, which includes fixes to maintain diagram aspect ratios on mobile. For the `YoutubePHP` project, I published phpDocumentor API references and uploader guides.

sections.title: Expanding engine capabilities and other tools
sections.body:
I have expanded the mechanics supported in `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket` by implementing graveyard-cast triggers and resolving a delay issue with cantrip draws through a persisted upkeep trigger. 

In other projects, I merged opt-in step-click controls for `NFG` and added desktop and mobile render reports to `Coffee's Crafts` that preserve artwork. For `Civilizationbot`, I merged updates to ensure the portable bot uses a verified default main branch for its startup and updates, alongside improved Windows lifecycle controls.

editions.headline: Updating the Civ13 launcher with new server options
editions.intro: I have released Windows launcher version 1.0.3, which adds support for `Civ13.com` servers via `Civ13#3234`.

sections.title: Engine and graphics refinements
sections.body: In `Civ13`, I merged several updates to the engine, including binding agent grass gathering to explicit wait contexts (`Civ13#3208`), refusing unmeasured world-z growth before allocation (`Civ13#3217`), and using switch dispatch for persistence exclusions (`Civ13#3197`). I am also continuing work on visual and mechanical refinements, including an audit of stone lifting weights and updates to lighting plane mask composition. To improve environmental immersion, I have opened an issue to add geometric line-of-sight occlusion with wall and opening shadows.

sections.title: Expanding card data in DiscordPHP-MTGPocket
sections.body: I have continued the effort to address card coverage gaps in `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket`, pushing frequent updates to expand the engine's ability to recognize and process more cards accurately.

editions.headline: Expanding card coverage in DiscordPHP-MTGPocket
editions.intro: I have merged a high volume of updates to `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket` to address card coverage gaps, specifically focusing on work related to `sc84tj`. This work continues the effort to ensure the engine can accurately process a wider variety of card interactions.

sections.title: Refinement of Civ13 interfaces and agents
sections.body:
In `Civ13`, I have merged updates to improve how players join lobbies and how join verbs are displayed. I also pushed updates to help maintain the user experience by restoring input runtime states.

To support further development of automated systems, I have started work on a new gameplay agent contract and new debug tools for bounded agents. This work aims to provide a more structured way to test and implement agent behaviors within the game environment.

editions.headline: Expanding Magic: The Gathering mechanics in DiscordPHP-MTGPocket
editions.intro: I have merged a series of updates to `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket` that expand the engine's ability to process complex Magic: The Gathering mechanics. This includes improved handling for various triggers—such as combat damage, creature death, sacrifices, and "intervening-if" conditions—as well as token types and specific card effects. To continue this expansion, I have opened a pull request to improve how the engine reads opponent spell kinds and defending-player attack triggers.

sections.title: Technical handoffs and library maintenance
sections.body:
In `Civ13`, I have handed off several investigations to a dedicated branch, including work on lighting-after-load behavior and chemical registration fixes. I also provided technical feedback regarding HUD blindness reconciliation, Linux native diagnostic loss, and CI failures to assist with ongoing troubleshooting.

Regarding the broader `DiscordPHP` ecosystem, I published release v10.68.0 and merged several pull requests. I am also reviewing a proposal to keep specific fields added by Discord within applications and search results.

editions.headline: Stabilizing world persistence and map transitions in Civ13
editions.intro: I have merged two updates to `Civ13` that improve data handling during critical transitions: preventing concurrent world saves and imports (`Civ13#3194`) and ensuring players are preserved when map transitions block the loading process (`Civ13#3195`). These changes build on recent efforts to make world-save restoration more reliable.

sections.title: Playtesting and map development
sections.body:
The `Civ13` Nomads persistence playtest is live on the ValZarGaming server, testing server updates, save/load recovery, and the stability of persistent rounds.

To support new content, I have opened a pull request for a four-level Dagger home map with protected core and build areas (`Civ13#3193`). I am also working on a "Europe lighting recovery" probe to trace startup and diagnostic behavior. On the infrastructure side, I updated the native launcher to report diagnostics for update failures and added loss-safe archival for admin history.

In my work on `Civilizationbot`, I opened a pull request to add isolated Windows TEST1714 startup support. I also refreshed the player roadmap on the `civ13.github.io` site and added a link to the latest launcher release.

editions.headline: Improving world recovery and gameplay mechanics in Civ13
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to `Civ13` that improve how the game handles world-save restoration, including excluding HUD graphs from saved worlds and validating added levels before recovery. To help with server management, I also added admin save restarts and automatic generation recovery.

sections.title: Gameplay and infrastructure updates
sections.body:
New mechanics are now live in `Civ13`, including staged flax, tow, and textile lint processing, buildable freshwater dew collectors, and realistic prepared meals with bounded quality rewards. I also merged changes to reduce food and water consumption during inactivity and a system to confirm firearm actions in chat. To help players navigate crafting, I added a dependency atlas with era and processor views.

Ongoing work aims to further refine the player experience and server stability. I have opened pull requests to reclaim players waiting through saved-world recovery, rebuild runtime lighting ownership during world recovery, and verify full-map Europe native save and recovery. I am also working on a proposal to show hovered object names on the HUD and a plan to bound recent combat histories while archiving older forensic records. On the infrastructure side, I am exploring the use of public game ports with explicit launcher overrides and a method to use verified BYOND for ValZarGaming server selections.

editions.headline: Improving the Civ13 launcher and web roadmap
editions.intro: I have merged a new, single-file self-updating Windows launcher for `Civ13` and updated the `civ13.github.io` site to include a player roadmap with validated navigation and automatic progress refreshes. To improve how the game connects to the launcher, I opened a pull request to resolve `valzargaming.com` for native connections, while ongoing work aims to refine how the launcher handles isolated launch configurations and local host verification.

sections.title: Simulation stability and resource management
sections.body:
In `Civ13`, I merged updates to retire chemical smoke reagent sources after emission and to bound retained runtime error detail history. I am also working on improving world-save restoration through two open pull requests: one aims to exclude client HUD graphs from saved-world restoration, and another aims to restore authenticated players to their saved bodies after a world load.

Work on `OpenDream` focused on bounding memory and CPU costs. I merged improvements regarding turf tile appearance updates, list pool backing capacity, and the release of disk-backed savefile read caches. To further optimize resource usage, I have opened pull requests that propose bounding idle DM list pool capacity and avoiding full text copies when resource output appends CRLF.

In the `DiscordPHP` ecosystem, I merged preparations for the v10.67.1 release, which includes compatibility updates for `libdave` and channel obfuscation.

editions.headline: Improving gameplay stability and documentation in Civ13
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to `Civ13` that refine core mechanics, such as improving AI gameplay assistance, ensuring food nutrition and age are preserved during the drying process, and managing paid-child transfers within saved game contents. To support players better, I also rewrote the Merchant guide for the wiki and added documentation for the North America Nomads map.

sections.title: Survival modes and engine development
sections.body:
Work on the extraction survival mode continues with efforts to define how faction-war persistence functions and defining custody phases. I have also proposed a plan for crash acceptance and opened a pull request to add a bounded Windows supervisor for isolated engine builds.

In my work on `OpenDream`, I focused on the `native-byond-bridge-proof` to manage object ownership. I opened and merged several pull requests aimed at ensuring that prompt snapshots, disconnected client references, and argument owners are released when procedure initializations fail or calls are rejected.

sections.title: Library and web updates
sections.body: I merged several updates to `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket`, which included adding support for uncontracted two-sentence creature fights, documenting the rules-engine architecture, and making land-entry life payments explicit and resumable. Additionally, I have integrated the `Civ13` website and game into both `DiscordPHP.org` and `valgorithms.com`.

editions.headline: Advancing game mechanics and performance in Civ13
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to `Civ13` that address game balance and performance, including fixes for digging exploits and issues with reagent processing and renewable mining. To further optimize the experience, I opened a pull request (`Civ13#3103`) aimed at improving lighting queue performance.

sections.title: Simulation and documentation progress
sections.body: Development on `Civ13` has moved into more granular mechanical territory, with work focusing on gun maintenance systems, component-based mechanics, and configurable attachments. I also addressed world-saving stability through bounded world saving and worked on extraction survival modes. To keep the community informed, I updated the official website and the wiki with new guides and details on various game modes.

sections.title: Library and bot maintenance
sections.body: In my other projects, I continued filling card coverage gaps in `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket` and merged a pull request to `DiscordPHP-MCP`. I also opened a new pull request for `TwitchPHP` and worked on a local verification replica for `Civilizationbot`, where I opened `Civilizationbot#16` to track recent updates.

editions.headline: Refining inventory mechanics in Frontier Systems
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to *Frontier Systems* that aim to improve how players interact with equipment and inventory, specifically regarding equipment prerequisites and how items are handed off within the inventory tray.

sections.title: Engineering and simulation progress
sections.body:
Work on *Frontier Systems* continued with new proposals to refine the client shell, including integrated panel layouts and production panel navigation. I also opened a pull request to verify panels inside the actual client shell and another regarding client input construction acceptance to help streamline how the simulation handles user commands. Further efforts focused on refining extraction mechanics, such as equipment transport and nested inventory transfer recovery. I have also opened new pull requests to address active hand extraction and nested inventory transfers.

In other areas, I worked on memory management and cleanup for `Civ13`, focusing on the water and season registries as well as observer references. I also merged a pull request regarding memory runtime and another proposing a plant terminal lifecycle. To support the project's growth, I updated the `Civ13` wiki with new player guides for current mechanics. I have also opened several issues to track upcoming features like sustainable mining, food lifecycles, hydroponics, and aquaculture.

Finally, I continued identifying gaps in card coverage within `DiscordPHP-MTGPocket`.

editions.headline: Improving UI and system mechanics in Frontier Systems
editions.intro: I have merged several updates to *Frontier Systems* that aim to improve how players interact with equipment and inventory, specifically regarding equipment prerequisites and how items are handed off within the inventory tray.

sections.title: Development across projects
sections.body:
Work on *Frontier Systems* continued with new proposals to refine the client shell, including integrated panel layouts and production panel navigation. I also opened a pull request to verify panels inside the actual client shell and another regarding client input construction acceptance to help streamline how the simulation handles user commands.

In other areas, I worked on memory management and cleanup for `Civ13`, focusing on the water and season registries as well as observer references. I also opened pull requests to address game verification and world save runtime evidence. To help support the ongoing maintenance of my libraries, I merged an Open Collective widget into both `DiscordPHP.org` and `valgorithms.com`.
